requirement: Usernames must be between 3 and 20 characters long, inclusive.
source_code:
def is_valid_username(username: str) -> bool:
    return 3 <= len(username) <= 20

reference_scenarios.description: A username of typical length (e.g. 8 characters) is valid.
A username of exactly 3 characters is valid (the lower bound, inclusive).
A username of exactly 20 characters is valid (the upper bound, inclusive).
A username of 2 characters is invalid (one below the lower bound).
A username of 21 characters is invalid (one above the upper bound).
An empty username (0 characters) is invalid, well outside the valid range.

notes: This requirement's boundaries are fully explicit ('between 3 and 20, inclusive'), so unlike the other three requirements there is no ambiguous or unvalidated input case worth flagging as a gap — every scenario here maps directly to stated behavior.
